  "states": ["SessionActive", "ConnectionClosed"],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "SessionActive",
      "event": "receive PUBLISH authorized",
      "action": "forward message",
      "to": "SessionActive"
    },
    {
      "from": "SessionActive",

      "to": "SessionActive"

      "event": "receive PUBLISH unauthorized QoS0",
      "action": "send DISCONNECT 0x87",
      "to": "ConnectionClosed"
    },
    {
      "from": "SessionActive",
      "event": "receive SUBSCRIBE authorized",
      "action": "send SUBACK success",
      "to": "SessionActive"
    },
    {
      "from": "SessionActive",
      "event": "receive SUBSCRIBE unauthorized",
      "action": "send SUBACK 0x87",
      "to": "SessionActive"
    },
    {
      "from": "SessionActive",
      "event": "forward PUBLISH unauthorized",
      "action": "send DISCONNECT 0x87",
      "to": "ConnectionClosed"

<json>
{
  "states": [
    "Authenticated",
    "Reauthenticating",
    "Disconnected"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "Authenticated",
      "event": "cond token_expired",
      "action": "send DISCONNECT Not Authorized",
      "to": "Disconnected"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authenticated",
      "event": "receive Not Authorized",
      "action": "send AUTH Reauthentication",
      "to": "Reauthenticating"
    },
    {
      "from": "Reauthenticating",
      "event": "cond reauth_fail",
      "action": "send DISCONNECT Not Authorized",
      "to": "Disconnected"
    },
    {
      "from": "Reauthenticating",
      "event": "cond reauth_success",
      "action": "set token_valid",
      "to": "Authenticated"
    }
  ]
}
</json>

<json>
{
  "states": [
    "Idle",
    "Connected",
    "Disconnected"
  ],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "Idle",
      "event": "receive CONNECT valid token",
      "action": "send CONNACK",
      "to": "Connected"
    },
    {
      "from": "Idle",
      "event": "receive CONNECT no token",
      "action": "close connection",
      "to": "Disconnected"
    },
    {
      "from": "Connected",
      "event": "receive PUBLISH auth fail",
      "action": "close connection",
      "to": "Disconnected"
    },
    {
      "from": "Connected",
      "event": "receive SUBSCRIBE auth fail",
      "action": "send SUBACK 0x80",
      "to": "Connected"
    },
    {
      "from": "Connected",
      "event": "forward PUBLISH token expired",
      "action": "close connection",
      "to": "Disconnected"
    }
  ]
}
</json>
